'''2017 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event, 5–7 May 2017. [[Tom Kelly]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Dates:''' 5–7 May 2017
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Kelly]]
